sections.title: Energy source
sections.text: Mains supply - The Adani SEZ mains, 415V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply is available.Mains is steady and less power cuts. Standby supply -02 numbers DG Set. a) “Sudhir” Make diesel alternators is provided at the station. Capacity of the DA set is 125 KVA, 415V, 3- phase, 50Hz, 1500 rpm. b) “kirlosker “ Make provided at the station Capacity of the DG set of 62.5 KVA, 6 cylinder 415V, 3- phase, 50Hz,1500 rpm. The power supply is controlled and distributed by an AMF panel in selectable‘auto/manual’ mode of operation.
